completion_media.name: RCH2_defined_noCarbon
completion_media.description: FEBA recipe: NH4Cl, KCl, NaH2PO4, PIPES (no BiGG id), Wolfe's mineral mix (Mg, NTA, Na, Mn, Co, Zn, Ca, Fe, Ni, Al, Cu, B, Mo, Se) and Wolfe's vitamin mix (pyridoxine, 4-aminobenzoate, lipoate, nicotinate, riboflavin, thiamine, pantothenate, biotin, folate, cyanocobalamin — represented by cbl1 and adocbl) Organic components listed under trace_components (vitamins, hemin, reductant amino acids, nucleobases) are limited to 0.001 mmol/gDW/h (ample for cofactor demands, negligible as carbon) so that they cannot act as carbon sources.
